title: Complete Monotonicity of the Srivastava-Tomovski Function and Its Laplace-Wright Realization: Necessary and Sufficient Conditions
summary: We determine necessary and sufficient conditions for complete monotonicity of the Srivastava--Tomovski extension, a generalized Mittag--Leffler kernel arising in fractional calculus, while separating the defining generalized-Wright series from its positive-axis realization when the series is not entire. For positive parameters, let \(Δ=1+α-κ\). In the entire regime \(Δ>0\), \(E_{α,β}^{γ,κ}(-x)\) is completely monotone on \((0,\infty)\) if and only if \(α\leqκ\) and \(κβ\geqαγ\).
